hard_laws: ARCHETYPE != ACTOR != MODEL != SKILL != TOOL != AUTHORITY
technology/vendor may change without changing the capacity archetype

archetypes.function: uncommitted compatible capacity before work selection
archetypes.authority: none
archetypes.verification: admission + capability + authority checks before morph

archetypes.function: cheap breadth: scout, gather, mutate, probe one hypothesis
archetypes.authority: observe/draft/sandbox only by default
archetypes.verification: evidence receipt; promotion only if information gain is real
morph: BANELING when a single destructive falsifier is needed

archetypes.function: single-use hostile falsifier aimed at one claim, artifact, or integration seam
archetypes.authority: sandboxed destructive test only; target hash required
archetypes.retry: 0; a repeat is a new Baneling
archetypes.verification: must be independent of producer; emits STRIFE evidence and dies

archetypes.function: recoverable bounded worker that owns one meaningful work item through turbulence
archetypes.authority: bounded reversible internal effects
archetypes.spawn: requests children through Queen/Hatchery, never self-mints authority
archetypes.verification: terminal evidence + independent verifier + ConsumerAck for promotion

archetypes.function: Roach promoted for a specific hard blocker requiring stronger targeted tools
archetypes.authority: narrow escalated effect ceiling tied to blocker
archetypes.verification: must show blocker removal without collateral scope expansion

archetypes.function: general-purpose throughput worker for ordinary coding/research/tool execution
archetypes.authority: standard workload effect ceiling
morph: LURKER when condition-watch/sentinel behavior is needed

archetypes.function: latent sentinel/condition watcher that wakes only on relevant state change
archetypes.authority: observe by default; bounded reaction if pre-authorized

archetypes.function: high-mobility scout/harasser for cross-domain reconnaissance and quick pivots
archetypes.authority: read/observe; narrow reversible probes

archetypes.function: telemetry, relay, capacity beacon and current-state projection
archetypes.authority: no material effects by default
morph: OVERSEER when active detection/attestation is required

archetypes.function: active observation, anomaly detection, identity/currentness attestation
archetypes.authority: observe/flag/hold; no self-promotion

archetypes.function: local macro allocator: match admitted demand to eligible capacity and maintain local production
archetypes.authority: allocation within admitted policy; not semantic truth authority

archetypes.function: delegated mission commander for a heterogeneous force package, able to continue under broken upstream comms using bounded intent
archetypes.authority: bounded mission command derived from explicit intent
archetypes.spawn: may request heterogeneous package through Queen/Hatchery
archetypes.verification: mission outcome + Telos gate + independent verifier

archetypes.function: periodic wave emitter using an existing scheduler to generate disposable workers
archetypes.authority: may emit only pre-admitted child phenotype

archetypes.function: mission-scoped parent that stays durable while projecting disposable subworkers at range
archetypes.authority: bounded child emission; no child self-authority

archetypes.function: surgical integration/repositioning: pull a blocked component, isolate dependencies, reshape local environment
archetypes.authority: narrow integration changes only

archetypes.function: controlled adaptation of external systems through adapters/plugins/context injection
archetypes.authority: strictly scoped external-system influence; high policy scrutiny

archetypes.function: rare evidence-promoted heavy executor/integrator that concentrates resources on a proven high-value lane
archetypes.authority: broader reversible internal effects, never self-expanding authority
archetypes.spawn: cannot recursively self-spawn; requests support through Queen
archetypes.verification: requires prior evidence before hatch and independent verifier after completion

archetypes.function: capital capacity platform that carries multiple force packages or large compute contexts; platform, not smarter identity
archetypes.authority: hosts admitted workloads; does not define Telos

archetypes.function: effectful builder converting disposable capacity into durable infrastructure/state
archetypes.authority: explicit infrastructure mutation required

archetypes.function: routing/handoff overlay connecting separated execution domains
archetypes.authority: transport only; no semantic authority

archetypes.function: shared operating substrate/context fabric that improves coordination where present
archetypes.authority: none by itself

archetypes.function: mutation, archive, frozen evaluation and selection; never producer self-scoring
archetypes.authority: selection only against frozen admitted fitness; no task invention
archetypes.verification: independent evaluator + later consumption assay for heritage

archetypes.function: compound virtual actor/control loop integrating Telos, memory, capacity, evidence and heterogeneous packages
archetypes.authority: only through explicit reference monitor/effect ceilings
archetypes.verification: system-level chaos/recovery + useful closure + memory continuity
archetypes.mosaic: the composed whole, not a tile

fca.formal_context: K=(G,M,I), where G is the source Zerg game/lore object set, M is engineering capacity attributes, and I marks whether an object materially exhibits an attribute. Archetype names are retained only when ablation shows a distinct reachable capability.

stable_concepts.note: Cerebrate retained as central-dependency anti-pattern, not preferred production archetype.
Legacy forms collapse unless they add a distinct measurable capacity.

source_inventory.variant_policy: Campaign/co-op/evolution variants are folded into their parent concept unless an ablation shows a distinct engineering capacity. A new name alone does not mint a new archetype.

mission_control_jadc2.mosaic_principle: compose force packages from capability tiles; loss or vendor removal should trigger substitution, not identity death
